Over 182 relationship managers and
branch managers were trained on
the environmental and social risk
assessment, across the Group.

In August 2019, we
successfully commissioned
the first fully Solar Hybrid
branch in the Bank network
at KCB Maasai Mara branch.
The 54 KW PV system
uses Solar as the primary
power supply supporting
all operations, which is
supplemented with back up
batteries and twin generators
for secondary supply.
